scope: All upstream PRs by scottgigawatt in Skare69/velvarr (PRs 1 and 2), including issue comments, review submissions, inline feedback, and subsequent confirmations; re-fetched for this review.

findings.topic: Connection status independent of configuration loading
findings.implementation: ConnectionsSettings keeps keyed cards mounted; status checks do not depend on the configuration request.
findings.evidence: Delayed-config and config-failure browser scenarios; no unrelated remount after Save.

findings.implementation: Shared SettingsSaveFeedback renders inside each connection, credential and AI editor directly after Save/Cancel, before destructive controls.
findings.evidence: Shared browser helper measures error position for Whisparr, TPDB, StashDB and AI; draft retention and retry assertions pass.

findings.implementation: Named Jellyfin and Whisparr h2 sections replace duplicate generic status headings.
Removed old connection layout rules; old grid and unused section class have no references.
findings.evidence: Repository search and complete Prettier check.

findings.topic: Valid forms and explicit button types
findings.implementation: Editors use sibling forms and explicit submit/button types.
findings.evidence: Production browser checks for nested forms and missing button types.

findings.implementation: Sections use labeled headings and status rows use aria-live; no unsupported generic div labels.
findings.evidence: Browser role/label assertions and unique ID check.

findings.topic: Disable fields when configuration is unavailable
findings.implementation: Fieldsets include configurationUnavailable; successful saves use the PATCH response without reloading configuration.
findings.evidence: Config-failure retry browser case and request-count assertions.

findings.topic: Distinguish upstream credential errors from local failures
findings.implementation: All three service-route paths use upstreamCheckError, an explicit allowlist shared in server/http.ts.
findings.evidence: Provider allowlist tests, local/decryption/unexpected-error identity tests, and real Jellyfin/Whisparr endpoint tests for upstream 401 and invalid local URLs.

findings.implementation: README retains explicit v0.40.0-and-earlier rollback instructions; this feature changes no persisted provider contract.
findings.evidence: README and diff review; existing judgment tests.

findings.implementation: One neutral operation queue is created in SettingsView through useSettingsOperations and passed to both tab components.
findings.evidence: Queue tests moved to settings-service.test.ts; browser tests cover blocking and ordering in both directions plus draft preservation.

findings.topic: Real editor focus instead of no-op disclosure state
findings.implementation: Transient Edit controls have no misleading disclosure attributes; focus enters editors and returns on close.
findings.evidence: Connection and AI editor focus browser checks.

findings.implementation: Settings is h1; service/provider cards are sibling h2 sections.
Shared save feedback separates persistence from probe outcomes; AI begin/saveStarted clears obsolete notices without resetting diagnosis.
findings.evidence: AI reducer regression tests and failed-after-success browser scenario, alongside existing configured/unconfigured AI and post-save failure cases.

findings.topic: Keep normalized post-save AI probe results
findings.implementation: Shared judgmentEditorSettings normalizes save/sync state; probes require configured settings.
findings.evidence: Normalized-save unit regressions and configured/unconfigured AI browser cases.

findings.implementation: Judgment sync effect still depends only on config and editor.saved.
findings.evidence: Source review; later upstream review confirms this fix.

additional_fix.implementation: Reuse existing settings-select styling and retain native labeled select elements.

service_specific_rules: Whisparr roots, quality profiles, delivery, mappings and removal
TPDB/StashDB credential preservation and environment fallback
additional_fixes: Removed repeated configuration load/save code, dialogs, feedback markup and check buttons; moved the operation queue and its tests to neutral shared files.
Applied the existing provider upstream error allowlist to Jellyfin and Whisparr; local and unexpected faults no longer become configured:true connection feedback.
Metadata and AI failed-save feedback now renders inside the editor beside Save/Cancel and above destructive controls; both tabs use the same feedback component.
Correcting TypeSafe/Ollama fields clears obsolete save errors.
Opening an AI editor or starting a new save clears stale success notices without dropping saved configuration or probe results.
Both tab components use the same parent configuration permission boundary; unavailable configuration disables editing while independent credential probes remain mounted.
